'''Mai''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3640 BBY]], shortly before the [[Battle of Corellia]], she was assigned as a personal assistant to [[Elin Garza]], the [[General/Legends|General]] of the [[Republic Special Forces Division]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lieutenant Mai appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during Chapter 3 of the Trooper storyline.
